name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
coverage_details: Cashless coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals for listed procedures.
application_steps: Check eligibility on the official PM-JAY portal or via the Ayushman card helpline
Visit the nearest empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk with ID proof
Get your Ayushman card verified or generated on the spot
note: SAMPLE DATA - income threshold simplified for demo. Real PM-JAY eligibility uses SECC 2011 deprivation/occupational criteria, not a flat income cutoff. Verify on the official portal.

name: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
coverage_details: Covers current and retired central government employees and their dependents at CGHS wellness centres and empanelled hospitals.
application_steps: Apply for a CGHS card through your department or pension disbursing authority
Use the card at any CGHS wellness centre or empanelled hospital
note: SAMPLE DATA - eligibility simplified for demo. Verify current rules on the official CGHS portal.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka
coverage_details: State top-up scheme covering Karnataka residents for a wide range of secondary and tertiary procedures.
application_steps: Register at a nearby government hospital or Arogya Mitra desk
Get your health card issued or verified
